title: Hancock Whitney, GNOF Offers $200K in Competitive Grant Opportunities
summary: Hancock Whitney, GNOF is now accepting Opportunity Grant applications. The deadline is October 30, 2026.
body_markdown:
### Awards advance financial empowerment, economic mobility across the GulfCoast


NEW ORLEANS


(October 8, 2026) —


For the ninth consecutive year, Hancock Whitney, in partnership with the Greater New Orleans Foundation (GNOF), is now accepting competitive grant applications from eligible non-profit organizations whose missions address improving financial literacy, promoting asset building and wealth creation, or preparing individuals for higher paying jobs through skill building and job placement.


**Applicants must apply through the GNOF online application portal by the October 30, 2026**


Eligible nonprofits include the following types of organizations:


- Workforce readiness agencies, job training programs


- Financial education providers


- Individual Development Account (matched savings) programs


The bank and foundation encourage organizations serving underserved and low-to-moderate income (LMI) communities to apply. Funding for the 2026 Hancock Whitney Opportunity Grants is part of Hancock Whitney’s Community Reinvestment Act (CRA) program.


"When people have the knowledge, skills and resources to achieve financial stability, entire communities benefit. Through our Opportunity Grant program, Hancock Whitney is investing in organizations that empower individuals to build wealth, advance their careers and create stronger futures for themselves and their families," said Hancock Whitney Senior Vice President, Director of Community & Economic Development, Ashley Aubrey Harrison.


GNOF manages the grant application process. Hancock Whitney reviews applications and awards grants to qualifying nonprofits according to a competitive assessment that measures overall community impact.


“Nonprofits are on the front lines of creating opportunities and improving the quality of life across our region. Through our partnership with Hancock Whitney, the Opportunity Grant program equips organizations with the tools, resources, and support they need to increase their impact and sustain their work over time,” said Andy Kopplin, Greater New Orleans Foundation President & CEO. “When we invest in these organizations, we help create stronger neighborhoods, a better-prepared workforce, and greater opportunity for future generations.”


Hancock Whitney supports 501(c)(3) organizations serving 35 assessment areas in Alabama, Florida, Louisiana, Mississippi and Texas. Last year, 18 nonprofits in five states earned Hancock Whitney competitive grants.


####
How to Apply


Now through October 30, 2026, eligible 501(c)(3) organizations located in one of Hancock Whitney’s 34 assessment areas may apply digitally for competitive grants of up to $25,000 through the Greater New Orleans Foundation online application portal by visiting


[www.gnof.org/program/hancock-whitney-opportunity-grant/](http://www.gnof.org/program/hancock-whitney-opportunity-grant/) .


All applications are due via the online portal no later than Friday, October 30, 2026. The Greater New Orleans Foundation will only accept applications submitted electronically. Applications received after the deadline will be ineligible for review.


The application process requires a tax identification number and includes a review for current standing with the Internal Revenue Service. By submitting a proposal, non-profit organizations consent to sharing their application, financial information, and other details related to their application with Hancock Whitney and the Greater New Orleans Foundation. Application documents are stored electronically.


####
Learn Before Applying


The Greater New Orleans Foundation technology partner, Foundant, created a brief tutorial for applicants at


[https://support.foundant.com/hc/en-us/articles/4479853059991-GLM-Applicant-Tutorial](https://support.foundant.com/hc/en-us/articles/4479853059991-GLM-Applicant-Tutorial) . Hancock Whitney and GNOF strongly encourage all applicants to watch this video before beginning a new application to better understand the application process.


##### About Hancock Whitney


Since the late 1800s, Hancock Whitney has embodied core values of Honor & Integrity, Strength & Stability, and Commitment to Service, Teamwork, and Personal Responsibility. Hancock Whitney offices and financial centers in Mississippi, Alabama, Florida, Louisiana, and Texas offer comprehensive financial products and services, including traditional and online banking; commercial and small business banking; private banking; trust and investment services; healthcare banking; and mortgage services. The company also operates combined loan and deposit production offices in the greater metropolitan areas of Nashville, Tennessee, and Atlanta, Georgia. More information is available at


[www.hancockwhitney.com](https://www.hancockwhitney.com/) .


##### About the Greater New Orleans Foundation


With roots extending 100 years, the Greater New Orleans Foundation connects generous people to the causes that spark their passion. As one of the most trusted philanthropic organizations in the region, we work every day to drive positive impact through philanthropy, leadership and action in our thirteen-parish region. In addition to grantmaking, we convene people, resources, and ideas to create intelligent strategies and solutions to meet our region’s greatest challenges. We are proud to serve as a vocal civic leader with our partners to ensure a vibrant, sustainable, and just region for all. Learn more at


[www.gnof.org](http://www.gnof.org/) .
